title: New Current Affairs: 15–20 Nov 2026 – Andhra Pradesh
bullets: **[20 Nov 2026] Cyclone Akvan** crossed the **north Andhra Pradesh–south Odisha coast near Gopalpur** between **7:30 and 8:30 am** as a **severe cyclonic storm** (winds 70–80 kmph, gusts to 90 kmph), then weakened into a cyclonic storm (IMD Amaravati and Bhubaneswar).

**[20 Nov 2026] Akvan rain in AP:** heaviest in **Srikakulam district** – **Ichchapuram mandal 16 cm**; Srikakulam told to stay alert even after the crossing; **four trains cancelled** and the **Hirakud Express** diverted.

**[17–19 Nov 2026] Akvan forecast vs. reality:** IMD had expected it to become a **very severe cyclonic storm** and cross **between Nellore and Tuni** on 20 Nov (winds 120–130 kmph, gusts 145 kmph); it actually crossed **further north (Gopalpur)** and **weaker**. Railway Minister **Ashwini Vaishnaw** reviewed railway preparedness on **18 Nov**.

**[17 Nov 2026] ONGC gas leak** at a drilling well in **Mamidikuduru mandal** (Razole constituency), **Dr B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema district**: about **800 people within 1 km** evacuated; brought under control after about **10 hours**, **no casualties**; at least the **fourth ONGC leak** in the district in 2026 (the January one was the **Mori-5** blowout). CM Naidu ordered a safety-protocol review with the **ONGC Chairman**.

**[20 Nov 2026] Andhra Pradesh Rare Earth Development Corporation (APREDC)** approved by CM **N. Chandrababu Naidu** at a Mines Department review – to develop and manage **rare earth minerals**, with focus on **exploration and value addition**.

**[20 Nov 2026] APMDC IPO:** the CM approved taking the **AP Mineral Development Corporation (APMDC)** public, with **listing targeted by December 2027**, and asked for a plan to make it a premier mining body **modelled on NMDC**.

**[20 Nov 2026] AP mineral base:** **582 mineral potential areas** over **74,860 sq km**, grouped into **209 clusters**; APMDC is bidding for **three coal blocks in Odisha and Jharkhand** (about **1,774.6 million tonnes**) to feed thermal plants; exploration and auctions to be speeded up over **five years**. Naidu: minerals are **future assets**, not just revenue.

**[20 Nov 2026] Small Modular Reactors (SMRs):** a **GO** approved exploring **nuclear power plants using SMR technology** as an **alternative to thermal power**, at **retiring thermal units** or other suitable sites, on a request from the **APGENCO** MD; **private sector participation** allowed; announced by Special Chief Secretary (Energy) **K. Vijayanand**.
**SMR context:** the Union Budget **2025-26** Nuclear Energy Mission aims at **at least five indigenous SMRs by 2033**; India's nuclear target is **100 GW by 2047**.

**[19–20 Nov 2026] Indirect local-body elections** (notified by the **AP State Election Commission** on 10 Nov): **MPP president and vice-president** in **659 Mandal Praja Parishads** on **19 Nov**; **ZPP chairperson and vice-chairperson** in **28 Zilla Praja Parishads** on **20 Nov**, by **show of hands** with members bound by **party whips**; the **TDP won all 16 MPP president posts in NTR district**.

mcqs.s: Cyclone Akvan, which hit the north Andhra Pradesh–south Odisha coast on 20 November 2026, made landfall near which place?
mcqs.x: Akvan crossed near Gopalpur (south Odisha) between 7:30 and 8:30 am on 20 Nov 2026. The IMD forecast had said Nellore–Tuni, but it crossed further north.

mcqs.s: Which district of Andhra Pradesh recorded the heaviest rainfall from Cyclone Akvan, with 16 cm in Ichchapuram mandal?
mcqs.x: Ichchapuram mandal of Srikakulam district, at the AP–Odisha border, recorded 16 cm.

mcqs.s: At what strength did Cyclone Akvan cross the coast on 20 November 2026, according to the IMD?
mcqs.x: It crossed as a severe cyclonic storm (winds 70–80 kmph) and then weakened into a cyclonic storm. It had been forecast to become a very severe cyclonic storm.

mcqs.s: The ONGC gas leak of 17 November 2026, which forced about 800 people to evacuate, occurred in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
mcqs.x: The leaking well was in Mamidikuduru mandal (Razole constituency) of Konaseema district, where the January 2026 Mori-5 blowout also took place.

mcqs.s: In November 2026 the Andhra Pradesh Government approved a new corporation called APREDC. It will deal with:
mcqs.x: APREDC = Andhra Pradesh Rare Earth Development Corporation, for exploration and value addition of rare earth minerals (CM's Mines review, 20 Nov 2026).

mcqs.s: The CM wants the AP Mineral Development Corporation (APMDC) to be developed as a premier mining body on the model of:
mcqs.x: APMDC is to be modelled on NMDC, and its IPO (listing by December 2027) was also approved.

mcqs.s: Which of the following was NOT among the decisions of the Andhra Pradesh CM's Mines Department review on 20 November 2026?
o: Setting up a Rare Earth Development Corporation
A ban on beach sand mining
Speeding up mineral exploration and auctions
mcqs.x: The review approved APREDC, an APMDC IPO and faster exploration and auctions over five years. No ban on beach sand mining was announced.

mcqs.s: In November 2026 Andhra Pradesh approved exploring nuclear power through SMR technology as an alternative to thermal power. SMR stands for:
mcqs.x: SMR = Small Modular Reactor. The GO allows plants at retiring thermal units or other sites, with private participation.

mcqs.s: The Andhra Pradesh Government's approval to explore Small Modular Reactors (November 2026) followed a request from which state utility?
mcqs.x: The GO followed a request from the Managing Director of APGENCO (AP Power Generation Corporation), the state's generating company.

mcqs.s: On 19 November 2026, indirect elections to the posts of MPP president and vice-president were held in how many Mandal Praja Parishads of Andhra Pradesh?
mcqs.x: 659 Mandal Praja Parishads elected MPP presidents on 19 Nov. The 28 Zilla Praja Parishads elected their chairpersons on 20 Nov.

title: New Current Affairs: 15–20 Nov 2026 – National
bullets: **[20 Nov 2026] India's first indigenous H5N1 bird-flu vaccine for chickens**, developed by **ICAR-NIHSAD, Bhopal**: an **inactivated** vaccine against **clade 2.3.2.1a** (the strain behind most chicken outbreaks); one dose protects for up to **six months**; dedicated by Agriculture Minister **Shivraj Singh Chouhan**; India first detected H5N1 in **2006** and has had **500+ H5N1/H5N8 outbreaks** since.

**[20 Nov 2026] 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI)**, **Goa**, **20–28 Nov 2026**, theme "**Stories Without Borders**"; opening film **"Fatherland"** by **Paweł Pawlikowski** (Best Director, Cannes 2026); **"Ramayana"** (Namit Malhotra) opens the **BRICS** segment and **"Dhurandhar"** the **Indian Panorama**.

**[19 Nov 2026] FICCI Annual General Meeting and Convention**, **Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi**, inaugurated by **PM Modi**; theme "**Bharat 2047**"; 2026-27 is FICCI's **centenary year** (100 years on **7 April 2027**).

**[19 Nov 2026] World Toilet Day:** the **Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation** launched the "**Swachh Shauchalay – Garimamay Bhavishya**" campaign under **Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen)**, running **19 Nov–10 Dec 2026**.

**[19 Nov 2026] Samaveshi Niti Sankalp 2026** – the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment's summit in New Delhi; PM Modi chaired the valedictory session and urged making **Nasha Mukt Bharat** a mass movement.

**[18 Nov 2026] Navy – 50 years of Long-Range Maritime Reconnaissance (LRMR):** golden jubilee of **INAS 312 'Albatross'**, commissioned in **1976** at **INS Hansa, Goa** with five **Super Constellation** aircraft from the IAF; later **Il-38 (1977)**, **Tu-142M (1988)**; today flies **P-8I** from **INS Rajali, Arakkonam** (Tamil Nadu).

**[18 Nov 2026] IISF 2026 curtain raiser** by **Dr Jitendra Singh** (New Delhi): the **12th India International Science Festival** will be held in **Pune** (first time), **19–22 Dec 2026**, theme "**India's Science, World's Future**"; organised by the **Department of Biotechnology** with **Vijnana Bharati (VIBHA)**.

**[18–24 Nov 2026] World AMR Awareness Week**, theme "**One Health, One Action: Prevent AMR Now**"; the Health Ministry inaugurated it at **Kartavya Bhawan**; India's policy – **National Action Plan on AMR 2.0 (2025–2029)**; AMR containment programme coordinated by **NCDC**.
**[18 Nov 2026] Karnataka Bank** appointed **Udaya Kumar Hebbar** as **MD & CEO** for three years, after interim chief **Biji S.S.** (from 16 Nov); the bank was founded in **1924**, HQ **Mangaluru**.

**[17 Nov 2026] MS Dhoni retired as an IPL player** and became **Chennai Super Kings' Team Mentor** from **IPL 2027**: about **5,439 runs in 278 IPL matches**; led CSK to **five titles (2010, 2011, 2018, 2021, 2023)**; **Ruturaj Gaikwad** remains captain; IPL 2027 auction on **16 Dec 2026** in **Goa**.

**[17 Nov 2026] Amazon** to invest **US$ 7 billion in renewable energy in India by 2030** (on top of about US$ 4 billion already contracted) and announced **four wind and solar projects of 934 MW** in **Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan** – including a **234 MW wind farm at Bijapur** (Sunsure), its largest wind project in Asia. India's target: **500 GW** clean energy by 2030.

**[17 Nov 2026] QS Sustainability Rankings 2027:** **IIT Delhi 194th** (up from 205th) – the **only Indian institution in the top 200**; then **IIT Kharagpur (224)** and **University of Delhi (237)**; world No. 1 **Lund University (Sweden)**, then **ETH Zurich** and **University of Toronto**.

**[17–19 Nov 2026] Exercise Sahayata Setu 2026** – the **IAF's Annual Joint HADR Exercise** at **Air Force Station Jamnagar (Gujarat)** under **South Western Air Command**; about **24 friendly countries** (incl. Sri Lanka, Nepal, Indonesia, Malaysia, Bangladesh) with MEA, Army, Navy and **NDRF**.

**[16–17 Nov 2026] 3rd DHR-ICMR Health Research Excellence Summit**, **Bharat Mandapam**, marking **115 years of ICMR**; ICMR crossed **100 technology-transfer deals**; launched syndromic surveillance under the **VRDL** scheme and the **Dr M.K. Bhan Young Medical Faculty PhD Portal**.

**[16–17 Nov 2026] 3rd NCCDFI** (National Conference on Cyber Security, Digital Forensics & Intelligence) by **NIELIT (MeitY)**, New Delhi, theme "**Cyber Secure Bharat**"; launched the **CyberVitals** and **Net Anveshak** apps; **Cyber Kushti 2026** hackathon.

**[16 Nov 2026] National Biodiversity Authority** launched **ABS Portal Phase III** – one application and one fee to approach several **State Biodiversity Boards**; legal base **Biological Diversity Act, 2002 (amended 2023)**.

**[Nov 2026] Air India and Airbus** signed a feasibility-study agreement at the **India Sustainable Aviation Fuel Summit** (New Delhi) for **India's first voluntary corporate SAF programme**; Indian Oil earlier got approval (17 Nov) to supply SAF from its **Panipat refinery**.

**[Nov 2026] Sports Ministry** set up a **14-member committee** to build a financially sustainable **sports league ecosystem** in line with **Khelo Bharat Niti** and **Viksit Bharat @2047** (Olympic, women's, youth and indigenous sports).

mcqs.s: India's first indigenous H5N1 bird-flu vaccine for chickens, dedicated in November 2026, was developed by which institute?
mcqs.x: ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases, Bhopal, developed the inactivated vaccine against clade 2.3.2.1a.

mcqs.s: Which film opened the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI), held in Goa from 20 to 28 November 2026?
mcqs.x: Paweł Pawlikowski's 'Fatherland' opened IFFI 2026. 'Ramayana' opened the BRICS segment and 'Dhurandhar' the Indian Panorama.

mcqs.s: What was the theme of the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) 2026?
mcqs.x: IFFI 2026 (Goa, 20–28 Nov) was themed 'Stories Without Borders'.

mcqs.s: The Indian Navy marked 50 years of Long-Range Maritime Reconnaissance on 18 November 2026, the golden jubilee of which air squadron?
mcqs.x: INAS 312 'Albatross' was commissioned at INS Hansa, Goa in 1976. It now flies P-8I aircraft from INS Rajali, Arakkonam.

mcqs.s: The 12th India International Science Festival (IISF 2026) will be held from 19 to 22 December 2026 in which city?
mcqs.x: IISF 2026 goes to Pune for the first time, with the theme 'India's Science, World's Future'. IISF 2025 was at Panchkula.

mcqs.s: Which campaign was launched under Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) on World Toilet Day, 19 November 2026?
mcqs.x: The Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation launched 'Swachh Shauchalay – Garimamay Bhavishya' (19 Nov–10 Dec 2026).

mcqs.s: In which state is the IAF's multinational HADR exercise 'Sahayata Setu 2026' (17–19 November 2026) held at an Air Force Station?
mcqs.x: Sahayata Setu 2026, the Annual Joint HADR Exercise, was held at Air Force Station Jamnagar, Gujarat, with about 24 countries.

mcqs.s: Which Indian institution was the only one in the global top 200 of the QS Sustainability Rankings 2027?
mcqs.x: IIT Delhi rose from 205th to 194th. IIT Kharagpur (224) was second in India. Lund University (Sweden) was first in the world.

mcqs.s: In November 2026 MS Dhoni retired as an IPL player and took up which role with Chennai Super Kings from IPL 2027?
mcqs.x: Dhoni became CSK's Team Mentor. He led CSK to five IPL titles, and Ruturaj Gaikwad stays as captain.

mcqs.s: In November 2026 Amazon announced an investment of how much in renewable energy projects in India by 2030?
mcqs.x: US$ 7 billion by 2030, on top of about US$ 4 billion already contracted, with four new projects of 934 MW.

mcqs.s: Who was appointed MD and CEO of Karnataka Bank for three years in November 2026?
mcqs.x: Udaya Kumar Hebbar succeeded the interim MD & CEO Biji S.S., who took charge after Raghavendra Srinivas Bhat's term ended on 15 Nov.

mcqs.s: Which of the following statements about World AMR Awareness Week 2026 is correct?
o: It was observed from 1 to 7 November 2026.
Its theme was 'One Health, One Action: Prevent AMR Now'.
India's AMR policy is the National Action Plan of 2010.
It is coordinated in India by ICMR alone.
mcqs.x: WAAW ran 18–24 Nov 2026 with the theme 'One Health, One Action: Prevent AMR Now'. India follows NAP-AMR 2.0 (2025–29), and NCDC coordinates AMR containment.

mcqs.s: FICCI, whose Annual Convention PM Modi inaugurated on 19 November 2026, completes how many years of its establishment on 7 April 2027?
mcqs.x: 2026-27 is FICCI's centenary year: it completes 100 years on 7 April 2027. The convention's theme was 'Bharat 2047'.

title: New Current Affairs: 15–20 Nov 2026 – International
bullets: **[19 Nov 2026] 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting, Shenzhen (China)**, chaired by **Xi Jinping**: adopted by consensus the **2026 APEC Leaders' Declaration** setting out the **Shenzhen Outlook** on building an **Asia-Pacific community**, plus **three outcome documents** on **trade, connectivity and innovation**.

**[19 Nov 2026] APEC – China's pledges:** **US$ 20 million** for APEC practical cooperation and a **Center for Asia-Pacific Community Studies in Shenzhen**; **Vietnam** hosts **APEC 2027** (2025 host: **Gyeongju, South Korea**). India is **not** an APEC member.

**[19 Nov 2026] First China–US–Russia trilateral summit** (**Xi, Trump, Putin**), **Shenzhen**, on the APEC sidelines: a **four-point statement** – **UN Security Council reform**, more **refined petroleum** supply, **immunity of state officials** (against ICC 'overreach'), and "**a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought**"; no mention of **Ukraine** or the **Iran** conflict.
**[17 Nov 2026] Earthshot Prize 2026** (6th edition; founded by **Prince William**) awarded in **Mumbai** – the **first time in India**; **five winners, £1 million each**.

**Earthshot 2026 winners:** **Mahindra Last Mile Mobility (India)** – Clean Our Air (affordable **electric rickshaws**); **Bhutan** – Protect and Restore Nature (**60% forest cover** required); **Ørsted (Denmark)** – Fix Our Climate (**offshore wind, 11+ GW**); **PFAS-Free France** – Build a Waste-Free World; **Niue Ocean Wide Trust** – Revive Our Oceans.
**[18 Nov 2026] PM Modi met the Prince and Princess of Wales** in New Delhi; the **India–UK CETA** entered into force in **July 2026**, guided by **India–UK Vision 2035**.

**[18 Nov 2026] Cambridge Dictionary Word of the Year 2026: "human"** – reflecting debate on being human in the age of **AI**; runners-up **analogue, agent, wholesome, chic**; earlier picks **"parasocial" (2025)** and **"hallucinate" (2023)**.

**[18 Nov 2026] 23rd India–Italy Joint Commission for Economic Cooperation (JCEC), Rome** – co-chaired by **Piyush Goyal** and Italy's Deputy PM and Foreign Minister **Antonio Tajani**; focus on automobiles, machinery, renewables; shared target of **€20 billion** annual trade **by 2029** (Joint Strategic Action Plan **2025–29**).

**[18 Nov 2026] COP31 (Antalya, Türkiye, 9–20 Nov):** **Bhupender Yadav** set India's position on the **Second Global Stocktake (GST-2)** – **equity and CBDR-RC**, a 360-degree review, and recognition that **climate finance and technology transfer** by developed countries fell far short.

**[20–22 Nov 2026] First SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum**, **Purana Qila, New Delhi**, inaugurated by **PM Modi**; organised by the **Ministry of Culture and MEA**; idea proposed by Modi at the **SCO Tianjin summit (2025)**; Pakistan's culture minister was invited – the first such invitation since **Operation Sindoor (May 2025)**.

**[18 Nov 2026] Juan Mata** (Spain, **38**) retired from professional football – **2010 World Cup** and **Euro 2012** winner, **Champions League 2012** with **Chelsea**; co-founder of the **Common Goal** initiative (2017); moves to administration at **Melbourne Victory**.
**[Nov 2026] Israel's RAFAEL** unveiled **SUPER ICE**, a precision **cruise missile** with a **1,000-pound (454 kg)** warhead (four times that of ICE BREAKER), launchable from **air, land and sea**.

mcqs.s: The 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting, held on 18–19 November 2026, took place in which city?
mcqs.x: Shenzhen, China, chaired by Xi Jinping. Gyeongju (South Korea) hosted APEC 2025, and Vietnam will host APEC 2027.

mcqs.s: The 2026 APEC Leaders' Declaration, adopted in November 2026, set out which document on building an Asia-Pacific community?
mcqs.x: The Shenzhen Outlook was adopted by consensus with three outcome documents on trade, connectivity and innovation. Putrajaya Vision 2040 dates from 2020.

mcqs.s: Which country will host the APEC meetings in 2027?
mcqs.x: Vietnam takes over from China (Shenzhen, 2026). India is not an APEC member.

mcqs.s: The first-ever trilateral summit of the leaders of China, the USA and Russia was held in November 2026 in which city?
mcqs.x: Xi, Trump and Putin met in Shenzhen on 19 Nov 2026, on the APEC sidelines, and issued a four-point statement.

mcqs.s: The Earthshot Prize 2026, held in India for the first time on 17 November 2026, was awarded in which city?
mcqs.x: The 6th Earthshot Prize Awards were held in Mumbai. The prize was founded by Prince William, and each winner gets £1 million.

mcqs.s: Which Indian company won the 'Clean Our Air' category of the Earthshot Prize 2026?
mcqs.x: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility won for affordable electric rickshaws.

mcqs.s: Which of the following was NOT a winner of the Earthshot Prize 2026?
mcqs.x: The five winners were Mahindra Last Mile Mobility, Bhutan, Ørsted, PFAS-Free France and Niue Ocean Wide Trust.

mcqs.s: Which word was chosen as Cambridge Dictionary's Word of the Year 2026?
mcqs.x: 'Human' won in 2026 because of AI. 'Parasocial' won in 2025 and 'hallucinate' in 2023; 'mogging' is Collins' 2026 word.

mcqs.s: The 23rd session of the India–Italy Joint Commission for Economic Cooperation was held on 18 November 2026 in:
mcqs.x: Rome, co-chaired by Piyush Goyal and Antonio Tajani. The 22nd session was held in Brescia (2025).

mcqs.s: India's first SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum (20–22 November 2026) was held at which venue?
mcqs.x: It was held at Purana Qila, organised by the Ministry of Culture and MEA. PM Modi proposed the forum at the 2025 SCO Tianjin summit.

mcqs.s: Juan Mata, who announced his retirement in November 2026, won the FIFA World Cup in 2010 with which country?
mcqs.x: Mata won the 2010 World Cup and Euro 2012 with Spain, and the 2012 Champions League with Chelsea.
